messages.text: Oh, thank goodness! They sent someone to get me out of here.
messages.raw: Oh, thank goodness! They sent someone to get me out of here.
messages.zh: 哦,谢天谢地! 他们终于派人来救我了。

messages.text: Do you know what they would've done if they found me?
messages.raw: Do you know what they would've done if they found me?
messages.zh: 要是被他们发现,你知道我会落得什么下场吗?
